Chief_Complaint.content: Soreness and cracked skin on hands and fingers

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Skin problem began approximately 3–4 months ago and has worsened recently
Skin symptoms are located on the palms
Symptoms include dry, cracked skin that is painful with intermittent itch
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Sx: dry, cracked skin; painful; intermittent itch

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Bleeding occurs only after scratching and is not spontaneous
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Bleeding: only after scratching; not spontaneous

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Hand symptoms are very painful and significantly impact ability to work
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Impact: hurts a lot; can’t really do job; off work past 3 days

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has been off work for the past 3 days due to hand symptoms

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Possible trigger is exposure to housekeeping and cleaning products
Symptoms are not consistently related to glove use
Job change to hotel housekeeping occurred about 4 months ago, involving bedrooms and bathrooms

Assessment.content: Hand dermatitis, likely contact dermatitis, chronic for approximately 3–4 months with palmar dryness, cracking, itch, and pain associated with cleaning work and chemical exposure and inconsistent glove use, affecting ability to work
Assessment.source_text: 1. Hand dermatitis, likely contact dermatitis — chronic (~3–4 mo) palmar dryness/cracking/itch/pain; assoc with cleaning work/chemical exposure and inconsistent glove use; affecting ability to work.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advise avoidance of triggers by wearing gloves at all times when cleaning
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Avoid triggers: wear gloves when cleaning at all times

Plan_of_Care.content: Start a stronger emollient and apply 3–4 times per day for the next couple of weeks
